thread:
leah_sales: NimbusBank POC just failed their second demo. They hit a cascade of 5xxs during a synthetic ramp. CTO is asking for cause + whether a short dedicated window is needed. Can we triage quickly?

dan_se: On it. Any request IDs or logs from their side?

priya_support: Received two request ids: nb-214f and nb-214g. They pasted a log snippet: 

priya_support: ```
2026-03-25T09:05:02Z ERROR serve: req=nb-214f status=502 err="evicted_kv_cache" node=gpu-c12 pool=burstpool seq=512 mem_pct=98
2026-03-25T09:05:02Z WARN  batching: window=200ms queued=48 flush=forced
2026-03-25T09:05:02Z ERROR autoscaler: scale_delay_ms=4100 reason="quota_throttle" requested=3 granted=0
```

tom_oncall: Looks like KV cache eviction + forced batching -> spike in work per request. Combined with quota throttle, autoscaler couldn't add nodes -> upstream 5xx. Were they running long contexts?

dan_se: Yes, their eval uses 6.5k token dialogues. Model=nimbus-7b-long. seq=512 in logs corresponds to chunked sequences; cache churn high.

javier_infra: Deploy bot shows cloud provider returned TOO_MANY_REQUESTS for node create calls at that time. Also our backup pool was configured but reserved for enterprise customers only.

deploy-bot: "cloud: node_create failed=3 code=429 reason=account_quota_limit account=nimbusbank-prod"

priya_support: Customer said they used our public endpoint (route=standard) and ramped to 30 concurrent sessions. They wanted to stress-test end-to-end.

leah_sales: They want to know if this is expected and whether we can promise no 5xxs for the next CTO demo.

dan_se: Short answer: not guaranteed on shared route under that concurrency + long context. Options: 1) route to Dedicated for demo window, 2) reduce concurrency and pre-warm nodes, 3) switch to long-optimized model with better KV handling.

javier_infra: Immediate fix we can push: open a temporary policy to allow backup_burstpool for their account and request a provider quota bump. Filed case #A-4321.

priya_support: I proposed a short mitigation checklist to their engs: 
- cap client concurrency to 12 sessions
- reduce seq length to 256 for synthetic load or use sampling to shorten contexts
- enable cache_policy: "retain_prefixes" and upload frequent prefixes via API

leah_sales: They asked about pricing: can we spin up a Dedicated pool for one day and credit it?

am_manager: We can do a one-day reserved demo with prorated billing or grant a demo credit depending on deal stage. I'll approve a small demo credit for this POC.

javier_infra: Note: even with Dedicated, long-context workloads can still spike GPU memory and cause eviction if model variant uses large KV. Recommend nimbus-7b-long-8bit variant for the demo.

priya_support: Also their security team asked for SOC2 + VPC. I shared SOC2 link and explained VPC onboarding takes ~3 weeks. They want the demo stable before any Private talks.

leah_sales: Ok. Can we schedule a controlled replay once infra has the quota bump and backup pool attached? NimbusBank preferred tomorrow morning.

javier_infra: Quota case escalated; ETA ~4 hours. I attached temporary backup policy to account until 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: "policy:backup_burstpool attached expires=2026-03-26T02:00:00Z account=nimbusbank-prod"

tom_oncall: During replay we'll watch: autoscaler_events, kv_cache_hit_rate, per-node mem/GPU util, and per-request tokenization sizes. If >0.5% 5xx reappear, escalate to runtime team for batching/kernel tweak.

dan_se: I'll prepare a lighter kernel build (smaller attention tiling) as a fallback, but that requires a quick model-team signoff.

priya_support: Sent the checklist and proposed time to their engineers. Also requested sample payloads and tokenization stats.

leah_sales: Can someone draft a one-line summary I can send to the CTO now?

javier_infra: "Root cause: KV cache eviction from long-context sessions + forced batching, compounded by cloud quota limits delaying autoscaler. Next steps: temporary backup burstpool, cap concurrency, use 8-bit long variant, or spin a short Dedicated pool. Infra requested quota bump and will run a controlled replay once uplift is in place." :thumbsup: 

leah_sales: Perfect. Sending. Will loop back after the replay.

am_manager: Finance okayed a small demo credit and a one-day reserved pool if they want a zero-risk demo; will follow-up with cost estimate.

tom_oncall: Replay scheduled 2026-03-26T09:00 UTC. I'll own the runbook and ops channel. Keep req ids handy.

leah_sales: Thanks team, closing thread."
